title: How to Download TikTok Without Watermark
description: Step-by-step guide to download TikTok videos without watermark in original quality.
h1: How to Download TikTok Without Watermark
intro: Three steps. It takes less than 10 seconds.

steps.title: Copy the link
steps.text: In the TikTok app, tap Share and Copy link. Short vm.tiktok.com and vt.tiktok.com links work too.

steps.title: Paste and search
steps.text: Paste the link above and press Search. We locate the original file TikTok serves publicly.

steps.title: Download
steps.text: Download the file in its original quality, straight from TikTok's servers to your device.

title: Frequently Asked Questions
description: Answers about downloading TikTok without watermark: quality, privacy, limits and legality.

faqs.q: Is it legal to download TikTok videos with TiktoMate?
faqs.a: Downloading public content for personal use is generally acceptable, but the content remains the creator's work. Credit the creator and get permission for commercial use.

faqs.q: Do I need to create an account or install anything?
faqs.a: No. Everything works in your browser on desktop, iPhone and Android. No app or extension required.

faqs.q: Do you store my videos on your servers?
faqs.a: No. We store nothing — no videos, no history, no searches. Files go straight from TikTok to your device.

faqs.q: What quality are the videos downloaded in?
faqs.a: The exact quality the creator uploaded, without recompression. If it was published in 1080p, you get 1080p.

faqs.q: Does TiktoMate work in the US and other countries?
faqs.a: Yes. TiktoMate works in the US, UK, Canada, Australia and anywhere TikTok serves content, with no geo-blocks.

faqs.q: What do I do if the download doesn't start?
faqs.a: Refresh the page and try again. Make sure the link is public and the video is still available on TikTok.

faqs.q: Why is a video sometimes only available with a watermark?
faqs.a: Some content is only served by TikTok with the watermark layer. We never fake a clean copy that doesn't exist.

faqs.q: Does it work with private videos or private accounts?
faqs.a: No. We only access what TikTok serves publicly without login. Private content is respected.
